task_instance: Produce an investor-ready TAM/SAM/SOM market-sizing analysis for AI-powered email marketing software targeting North American e-commerce stores with >$1M revenue, using the skill's three-methodology framework (bottom-up + top-down with triangulation).
evidence: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md. Produced the core deliverable as market-sizing-ai-email-marketing.md in the work directory: a structured analysis following the skill's Steps 1-6 (market definition, documented assumptions, top-down TAM/SAM, bottom-up TAM/SAM, SOM ramp, validation). Verified the deliverable by hand-recomputing every formula: top-down SAM = 7.5B x 0.40 x 0.35 x 0.60 = 0.63B; bottom-up SAM = 600000 x 0.60 x 1800 = 648M; the two methods triangulate to 2.8% apart (within the skill's 30% threshold); SOM = 640M x 2% = 12.8M (Yr3) and x 5% = 32.0M (Yr5); all values pass the skill's red-flag guardrails (TAM > 1B, SOM < 10%). The skill is an analytical/writing task whose deliverable is a text document requiring only arithmetic and prose, no code execution, binary output, or external services. Industry data lookups would normally be gathered via web/reports but were disabled for this round; per the skill, assumptions are permitted when clearly documented, so the methodology deliverable was fully produced and self-consistent.
